## Problem

What problem do you want to solve? For example: "When I open a large workbook, I cannot ...".

## Proposed solution

Describe what you would like FileStudio to do.

## File type

<!-- Put an x in the box: [x] -->

- [ ] `.xlsx`
- [ ] `.csv` / `.tsv` / `.psv` / `.ssv`
- [ ] `.md` / `.markdown`
- [ ] `.docx`
- [ ] `.pdf`
- [ ] `.pptx`
- [ ] A new file format: <!-- which one? -->
- [ ] General / all formats

## Alternatives

Other solutions or workarounds you have considered.

## Additional context

Screenshots, sample files or examples from other tools (for example Excel or Word) that show the idea.

- [ ] I would like to help build this feature.
